instructions.content: After EVERY AskUserQuestion call, check whether the answers are empty or blank.
If answers are empty, DO NOT proceed with assumptions: output the warning, present the options as a numbered text list and WAIT for the user's reply.
Parse the first word of $ARGUMENTS as the subcommand.
For anchor, read references/protocols/anchor.md and execute it.
For verify, read references/protocols/verify.md and execute it.
For framing, read references/protocols/framing.md and execute it.
For deep, spawn a devil's advocate sub-agent via the Agent tool.
With no subcommand, use AskUserQuestion with the four options (anchoring, factual accuracy, framing, high stakes).
Dispatch to the subcommand matching the user's answer.
DO NOT pass the parent conversation's reasoning to the deep sub-agent; fresh context is the point.
The deep sub-agent runs all 9 patterns across anchor, verify and framing comprehensively.
For every finding make reasoning explicit: Observation, Technique family and pattern, Reasoning, Confidence.
Produce a structured Challenge Report for all subcommands, not prose.
NEVER challenge without the anchor protocol first; establish shared facts before disagreement.
NEVER challenge the person, only the proposal.
NEVER issue a challenge without proposing an alternative.
NEVER run deep on a trivial or low-stakes target.
NEVER suppress or soften findings to avoid conflict.
Do not run a challenge when the same subcommand was already run on the same target with no new evidence, or when the stakes are low and time is under five minutes.
